title: Construction of the exterior dual determinant pairing
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $M$ a sheaf of $\mathcal O_X$-modules, $M^\vee=\mathcal Hom(M,\mathcal O_X)$ its internal dual [def-pur-sheaf-hom], and $n\geq0$. For the sheafified exterior powers and wedges of local sections [def-sc-sheaf-exterior-power], there exists a morphism $f:\bigwedge^n M^\vee\to(\bigwedge^n M)^\vee$. For every open $U$, every $a_i\in M(U)$ and $\varphi_j\in M^\vee(U)$, its value on $\varphi_1\wedge\cdots\wedge\varphi_n$, evaluated on $a_1\wedge\cdots\wedge a_n$, is $\det(\varphi_j(a_i))$. No local freeness assumption is needed.

proof.text: Choose the uniquely characterized upstream alternating family A on each open using exterior_dual_pairing_local. Prove its restriction compatibility by exteriorSheaf_dual_ext: on every subopen both functionals have the same determinant evaluation, and internal Hom restriction composes the subopen arrows definitionally.

Apply exteriorPower.alternatingMapLinearEquiv to A on each open to obtain a map from PresheafOfModules.exteriorPower of the internal dual into the internal dual of exteriorPower M n. Prove naturality by exteriorPower.linearMap_ext and exteriorPower_map_ιMulti: on pure wedges it is exactly the preceding restriction compatibility.

Extend the presheaf morphism through the sheafification adjunction. Its hom-equivalence apply_symm_apply identity identifies precomposition with the unit with the original presheaf morphism. Evaluate this identity first on a pure wedge of dual sections and then on a pure wedge of M sections; the local determinant formula at the identity subopen gives the conclusion. The upstream declaration uses exteriorPower and wedge; earlier exteriorSheaf consumers use the canonical wedge-preserving comparison in their own proofs.

theorem exterior_dual_pairing_exists (X : Scheme.{u}) (M : X.Modules) (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ f :
    (Scheme.Modules.exteriorPower (Scheme.Modules.dual M) n) ⟶
      Scheme.Modules.dual (Scheme.Modules.exteriorPower M n),
    ∀ (U : X.Opens) (a : Fin n → M.val.obj (op U))
      (φ : Fin n → (Scheme.Modules.dual M).val.obj (op U)),
      (f.val.app (op U) (wedge (M := Scheme.Modules.dual M) (r := n) (U := U) φ)).app
          (op (Over.mk (𝟙 U)))
        (wedge (M := M) (r := n) (U := U) a) =
      (Matrix.of fun i j ↦
        (show X.presheaf.obj (op U) from
          (φ j).app (op (Over.mk (𝟙 U))) (a i))).det
